Results.ReviewText:
Our family has always had Weber grills.  When my 15-20 year old Weber propane grill had seen better days, the only question was what Weber grill would replace it.  Purchased a Spirit E-310.  First thing I noticed was the 3 burners were vertical rather than horizontal that I had been used to.  After starting to use the grill, I liked the configuration much better.  
Regarding performance, grill heats up quickly to 500+ degrees extremely fast.  I have cooked on high heat a couple of times and very pleased with performance.  Also, cooked ribs low a slow.  Spirit E310 maintained a constant low temperature - in indirect heat with 1 burner on - around 225-230 degrees. Great gill for reverse searing.  Can not be more pleased.
Results.Title: Versatile at all grilling temperatures

Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.
